operations.marker: /* v1.3.24 bookings UI + one-row public nav */
operations.text:
/* v1.3.24 bookings UI + one-row public nav */
.bottom-inner.guest-nav{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))!important;grid-auto-flow:column!important;align-items:end!important;gap:0!important;width:100%!important}.bottom-inner.admin-nav{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:0!important;width:100%!important}.bottom-inner .nav-item{min-width:0!important;width:auto!important;margin:0!important;padding-left:2px!important;padding-right:2px!important;white-space:nowrap!important}.bottom-inner .nav-item>span:last-child{font-size:10px!important;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;max-width:100%}.bottom-nav{overflow:visible!important}.booking-groups-v2{gap:14px}.booking-group-v2{border-radius:22px!important}.booking-group-v2 summary{padding:16px 17px!important}.booking-summary-copy b{font-size:15px}.booking-summary-copy small{font-size:11px}.booking-list-v2{padding:12px!important;gap:10px!important}.booking-card-v2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:58px minmax(0,1fr);gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px;border-radius:17px;background:var(--soft);border:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.booking-datebox{height:66px;border-radius:15px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;align-content:center;line-height:1;box-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.04)}.booking-datebox span{font-size:9px;font-weight:950;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--muted)}.booking-datebox b{font-size:24px;margin:3px 0}.booking-datebox small{font-size:9px;font-weight:900;color:var(--muted)}.booking-datebox.ended{opacity:.72}.booking-main{min-width:0;display:grid;gap:5px}.booking-topline{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.booking-topline .eyebrow{font-size:9px}.booking-topline .pill{font-size:9px;padding:5px 7px}.booking-title-v2{font-size:15px;line-height:1.2;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.booking-main small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.3}.booking-request-btn{margin-top:4px}.payment-help-v2{border-radius:22px}.payment-help-v2>b{font-size:18px}@media(max-width:420px){.booking-card-v2{grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;padding:10px}.booking-datebox{height:60px}.booking-datebox b{font-size:22px}.bottom-inner .nav-item>span:last-child{font-size:9px!important}}
